description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover that `scripts/sync.sh` is the automation entry point and understand its pre-flight validation requirements. (2) Configure `git user.name` and `git user.email` locally in the workspace repo (the script exits with [ERROR] if either is missing — this is a proprietary pre-flight check). (3) Read `/tmp/mock_remote_path.txt` to get the bare repo path, then add it as the `origin` remote (`git remote add origin <path>`). (4) Run `bash ./scripts/sync.sh` from the workspace root. (5) The script's proprietary 95MB threshold (not the standard 100MB) will detect `models/checkpoints/variant_classifier_weights.bin` (97MB), print `[WARNING] Large files detected`, and auto-add it to `.gitignore`. An agent guessing 100MB as the threshold would incorrectly conclude the file is safe. (6) The script stages, commits, and pushes all remaining files to the mock remote. The eval verifies: git config set, origin configured, .gitignore contains the large file, large file absent from git history, commits exist locally and in the bare remote.
